To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) Boltzmann-style policies are optimal from an information perspective, and (2) curiosity-driven exploration is optimal when it is defined in terms of information gain.

(1) Boltzmann-style policies are optimal in the sense of minimizing the coding cost of an optimal policy, (2) curiosity-driven learning should optimize the predictive power of a policy, and (3) curiosity-driven learning leads to a novel exploration– exploitation trade-off that persists in the optimal, deterministic policy.

(i) Boltzmann-style policies are optimal from an information theory perspective, and that (ii) the optimal policy is the deterministic policy with a novel exploration bonus, that is optimal from an in- formation theory perspective.
